svg.title: NYC Taxi Data Engineering — roadmap-gantt
svg.desc: Twenty-six tasks across milestones M1 through M8. Status as of 22 September 2026: M1 and M1.1, M1.2, M1.3, M2.1, M2.2, and M2.3 are complete. M2.4, M3.1, and M4.1 are ready to start. Other tasks remain incomplete. Steps 00 through 10 show illustrative dependencies, not effort or dates. Optional extensions and transversal activities remain unchanged.
